#include <iostream>
#include <string>

using namespace std;

int main() {
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    
    // Replace first occurrence of "at" with "@" if not at the beginning
    size_t atPos = s.find("at");
    if (atPos != 0 && atPos != string::npos) {
        s.replace(atPos, 2, "@");
    }
    
    // Process "dot" occurrences
    bool startedWithDot = (s.find("dot") == 0);
    size_t dotPos;
    while ((dotPos = s.find("dot")) != string::npos) {
        s.replace(dotPos, 3, ".");
    }
    
    // Restore "dot" at beginning if originally started with "dot"
    if (startedWithDot) {
        s.insert(0, "dot");
    }
    
    cout << s;
    return 0;
}
